content:
A new Apple TV app landing on tvOS is not an everyday occurrence. WordPress has just launched the WordPress TV app, bringing video content to the big screen.

According to the app's description, WordPress TV is a brand-new way to watch on Apple TV "thousands of free talks, tutorials, and WordCamp session recordings from WordPress meetups and events."

The following is a detailed introduction to the WordPress TV app:

The video library of the WordPress community, now on your TV. WordPress TV brings the complete WordPress.tv catalogue to the big screen—featuring thousands of free talks, tutorials, and WordCamp session recordings from WordPress meetups and events around the world. You can sit back on your sofa and learn from the people who build and use WordPress every day. The app is built natively for Apple TV, designed to feel natural and intuitive from the couch: browse a clean poster-grid layout with your remote, press play, and enjoy smooth full-screen HD video straight away. The content you can watch includes • WordCamp session recordings from events around the world • Design, development, business and

You can download WordPress TV from the App Store on Apple TV.
